notes: Pioneers' Coalition assignment, Type 'Clearing The Way'. The work zone is Kamihr Drifts from the assignment table's Zone column, which is a different zone from the giver's. TWO DELIBERATE OMISSIONS. (a) The reive can be at any of four sites and the objective is completion of the reive, not a named monster, so the fight step carries no grid and no mobs; recording (H-8)'s Chilblain Snoll and Umberwood Tiger would point the marker at one site out of four and the other three are written only as '??? Monsters'. (b) There is NO report-back bullet on this page -- the walkthrough ends at 'participate in one Colonization Reive through to completion' -- so no return-to-the-delegator rung was added. Sibling Courier assignments (Provide/Deliver) do spell out 'Return to the Task Delegator', but importing that here would be exactly the cross-page import the pipeline forbids. If play shows a report step is required, it belongs after step 2 at Western Adoulin (E-8). gates.repeatable and gates.expansion are null because the page never states either in words.
